title: The Tether
logline: In the paddy lands of the north, a herder moves buffalo from stake to stake. Each animal grazes a perfect circle and cannot leave it. Some wander free trailing their ropes, and come back at dusk anyway.
human_question: What keeps us going round the same circle, even when the rope is long?

premise.story: One herder's day and season: moving stakes, untying and retying, bringing the herd home, and the herder's own account of the animals, the land and their livelihood.
premise.place: Harvested paddy fields and tank bunds in the dry north, flat to the horizon, with worn circles in the stubble around each stake.
premise.experience: Slow, hot, repetitive rhythm; the viewer begins to see circles everywhere without being told to.

concept_links.why: The fetters are explained with this image: a cow on a long rope tied to a post can move but never leaves its circle, and cows let loose with their ropes still attached roam further but are not free (P L544, L621–L623; M L90).
The roots hold the mind firmly on its object as a tree's roots hold it standing [C033-M:L5–L7]: what keeps a thing in place, not what started it.

what_camera_could_observe: Animals tethered at dawn and the grazed circles around each stake
The herder pulling stakes, walking, hammering them in again
An animal wandering off with its rope still trailing
Water at the tank, egrets, heat haze
Dusk: bringing the herd home and tying them again
what_must_be_real: The herder's real work, animals and livelihood. The rope and circle are never set up or lingered on as a sermon.

possible_arc.opening: Dawn, a stake, a circle of bare ground.
possible_arc.turn: An animal wanders loose, still trailing its rope.
possible_arc.ending_open: Dusk and the retying. Whatever the herder says about their animals and their own days closes the film.

requirements: A herder with tethered buffalo or cattle on open paddy or tank land
A season when the grazing circles are visible
The herder's consent to be followed over several days

suggestions.name: Paddy and tank lands of the Vanni
suggestions.region: Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu districts, Northern Province
suggestions.why: Broad dry-zone paddy country where cattle and buffalo graze on fields and tank bunds.
suggestions.season_notes: After harvest, when fields are open to grazing
suggestions.verify: Region-level suggestion; confirm tethered grazing is practised and find a herder.

risks: Heavy-handed symbolism if the rope shot is cut too neatly
Reducing the herder to a metaphor
Post-war sensitivities in the north must be respected
drop_if: No herder in the region tethers animals in this way

connections.note: Being tied, in two kinds of rural work.
What holds by tethering here; what holds by rooting in the mangroves.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
